composition_label: Guided setup (Guided onboarding) -> Interest-based recommendations (Personalized discovery)

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch for this isolated build

input.onboarding.completed_steps: Ordered prefix of profile, consent, preferences. Each object has step_id and answers.
input.preferences.answers: Unique nonempty ranked_interests array; unique excluded_categories and excluded_item_ids arrays (may be empty)
input.discovery.catalog: Array of unique-id objects with id, title, category and unique string-array tags

output.success: schema_version, fixture_label, status=ok, onboarding progress, discovery results or skipped reason
output.failure: status=error and error string; CLI exit 2

shared_schema.validation: Shared exact-field, text, array and requirement validators reject unknown/missing fields, whitespace-padded or empty strings, invalid types, duplicates, invalid prerequisites, non-finite JSON constants and duplicate JSON object keys. All catalog data is validated even if onboarding is incomplete.
shared_schema.matching: Case-sensitive exact matches; no inferred synonyms or taxonomy. Unknown interests and exclusions are accepted.

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: Immutable DiscoveryContext containing validated user_id, ranked_interests, excluded_categories and excluded_item_ids. Created only after all three prerequisite-ordered steps pass and consent is true.
cross_stage_handoffs.gating: Incomplete onboarding skips discovery. Declined consent blocks preferences and skips discovery. Out-of-order or duplicate steps fail validation.

behavior.progress: Reports completed steps, counts, percentage, per-step completed/available/locked states, next step and blocked reason. Resume by submitting an extended valid completed_steps prefix.
behavior.ranking: For N interests, rank i (zero-based) weighs N-i. Sum weights of exact category/tag matches; count each interest once even if present in both fields.
behavior.exclusions: Excluded categories or item IDs remove candidates before scoring, regardless of interest strength.
behavior.explanations: Every recommendation exposes matched interest, input-derived weight, exact category/tags evidence source and total score.
behavior.ties_and_limit: Descending score, ascending item id; apply limit only after filtering and ranking. Report pre-limit eligible count, excluded count and unmatched count.
behavior.no_matches: Return successful empty recommendations, never irrelevant filler.
behavior.execution: Stateless deterministic pipeline; does not modify inputs or persist user data. One JSON object on stdout.

included: Prerequisite enforcement and resumable input-driven progress
Consent gating, ranked interests, hard exclusions and grounded explanations
CLI JSON and file error handling
excluded: Authentication, external storage, UI and production deployment
Learned rankings, fuzzy matching and collaborative filtering
Enterprise-scale ingestion and durable onboarding sessions

test_outcomes.example_result: Complete onboarding; two grounded recommendations; two exclusions; one unmatched item.
